# E1001: a lens on the edge into the tip is missing

The tip removes a field without writing a `ForwardLens` that says where the
field goes, so the lens on the edge into the tip cannot be derived. The
development path binds the lineage anyway, without that lens, and reports it
as a warning: the edge is still being written. The warning is at the end of
`tip.thema`, where the missing lens would be written. The derivation's own
findings are the notes, each with its code, and their fixes are the help.
Translating across the missing lens fails (E1002); binding the history alone
never reads the tip.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
}
```

thema reports:

```
warning[E1001]: tip.thema has no ForwardLens, and one cannot be derived
 --> tip.thema:3:1
  |
3 | }
  | ^
  | - 0.0 declares b and tip does not, and nothing maps it (E0347)
  |
  = note: translating from 0.0 to tip needs it; until tip.thema writes it, that translation fails (E1002)
  = help: write ForwardLens: {v0_0: _, tip: {...}} in tip.thema
  = help: write <field>: v0_0.b to move it, or b: _drop

warning[E1001]: tip.thema has no BackwardLens, and one cannot be derived
 --> tip.thema:3:1
  |
3 | }
  | ^
  | - tip.thema has no BackwardLens, and 0.0 requires b (E0346)
  |
  = note: translating from tip to 0.0 needs it; until tip.thema writes it, that translation fails (E1002)
  = help: write BackwardLens: {tip: _, v0_0: {b: <mapping>}} in tip.thema
```
